one_liner: Ranks every number by how long it has been absent, in the direction learned from the data (Method A).
registry_status_reason: Revision 1 installed for review and not yet released (E2R-R58): IN_DEVELOPMENT.txt is present and no SUPPORTED entry exists.
short_explanation: E_17 looks at how long each number has been away since it was last drawn. It measures, over all the numbers together, whether a number is more or less likely to come up the longer it has been absent, using the logarithm of the absence (the owner's Method A). If longer absence goes with more appearances, it ranks the longest absent first; if with fewer, the most recently drawn first; if neither, all numbers tie. It ranks the numbers by that value: its top pick is the highest-ranked numbers and its inverse pick the lowest-ranked, with exact ties settled by the project tie rule (TIE_SHA256_V1). Its scores are not chances, so no probabilities are published. It uses only which numbers were drawn, not their order or the dates, and needs 52 earlier draws. If the draws are fair, it is not expected to beat chance.
